description: API keys are not on sale at the moment: every plan answers "This plan is not on sale." and no order is created. When the sale opens this tool returns a payment address, an exact amount in a stablecoin the chosen chain accepts (ethereum, solana and avalanche: USDC or USDT; bnb: USDC, USDT, USD1 or U; polygon: USDC, USDT or USDC.e; tron: USDT; sui: USDC) and a claim token for the chosen plan and payment chain

chain.description: Payment chain: ethereum, solana, bnb, polygon, tron, avalanche or sui. Example: bnb

email.description: Email address for the key and receipt, required for the alerts plan. Example: ops@example.com

plan.description: Plan: standard, pro or alerts. Example: standard

name: buy_key

outputSchema.description: order terms for an API key: what to pay, where, and the order id to poll
